source: Owner review export 2026-10-16 (917 votes: 744 LIKE, 173 NOT) plus owner statements 2026-10-15/16. Human-readable version: docs/art/OWNER_TASTE_RULES.md

score.formula: total = sum(score_i * weight_i) / 10   (weights sum to 100, so total is 0-100)

criteria.name: glance_read
criteria.question: Can it be named in one second at 48 px, in greyscale, blurred? Is the glyph clearly lighter/darker/different hue than its base?

anchors.0: blob or ambiguous; needs colour or text to identify
anchors.5: identified after a second look, or glyph and base are close in value
anchors.10: one bold silhouette, one dominant colour, instant

criteria.name: detail_budget
criteria.question: Count separate visual elements (parts, glints, keyholes, flags, rivets beyond the frame, texture patterns). Within the budget of its role tier?

anchors.0: more than 2x budget, or a textured fill (grain, rust, mosaic, constellations)
anchors.5: about 1.5x budget, or shine plus small details
anchors.10: at or under budget, no shine streaks, no micro detail

criteria.name: one_visual_language
criteria.question: Glossy chunky toy-machine: thick warm-dark outline, one soft top-left highlight, brass/gold rim, saturated mostly-flat fill. Matches the liked anchors side by side?

anchors.0: hyper-real, flat hairline, or a different hand and palette
anchors.5: close but thinner outline, grey/desaturated, or a second light source
anchors.10: indistinguishable from the liked ch1-3 roads, rank badges, resource icons, core board v1

criteria.name: role_hierarchy
criteria.question: Does the supporting piece stay quieter than what it supports (road under plates, backdrop under board, FX tail under the grid, badge under its label)?

anchors.0: steals the eye from the plates / board / grid

criteria.name: set_distinctness
criteria.question: Next to its siblings in greyscale, does it differ in at least two of colour, shape, texture? Is it a duplicate of a better liked asset?

anchors.0: same hue and shape as a neighbour, or a weaker duplicate
anchors.10: differs in colour and shape (and texture)

criteria.name: machine_toy_cues
criteria.question: 1-2 workshop cues (brass, rivets, cogs, gauges) present but not piled on. Not photoreal wood or rust, not generic fantasy.

anchors.0: no machine feeling, or hyper-real wooden toy / rust
anchors.5: generic game UI, no machine cue
anchors.10: clearly a chunky toy workshop machine part, 1-2 cues

criteria.name: phone_thumb_scale
criteria.question: At real phone size (390 pt wide screen) is it readable and, if tappable, thumb sized?

anchors.10: big, thick, readable at arm's length; side badges at least ~48 pt

criteria.name: consistency_semantics
criteria.question: Matches established characters, ranks and states? Shape count = number? Meaning obvious without text?

anchors.0: off-model mascot, wrong spike count, unclear meaning
anchors.10: fully consistent with the family and its siblings

micro.examples: badges, glyphs, buttons, bars, FX, road pieces, tool chips

hero.examples: chests, props, offer frames, rank 8, resource hero icons, landmarks

fx.examples: tool shots, impacts, surges (judged at 48 px blurred; fine particle dust does not count)

screen.detailBudget: 1 hero + at most 3 focal zones, calm backdrop

hardFails.rule: Photoreal or grunge surface (wood grain, rust, stone, fabric) as the main fill of a small or repeating piece (road tile, button, badge). A single hero-size object is exempt.
Road or backdrop piece with a surface pattern of more than 2 tones at tile scale, inlays, constellations, mosaics, props or glow on the road itself.
Badge or small icon with shine streaks plus more than 4 separate elements (extra keyholes, flags, specular dots, small flourishes).
FX that combines 3 or more ideas (object + trail + orbit lines + sparks), or shares hue and shape with a sibling FX.
Shape count does not match the number (rank 7 needs 7 spikes), or a character is off-model (mascot).
Unit or machine not identifiable at 48 px greyscale, or more than 7 readable parts.
Screen or mock with more than 3 competing focal zones, or a detailed top/backdrop that competes with the board or plates.
Wrong language: hairline unoutlined flat shapes among glossy outlined ones, hyper-real art, or palette outside gold/brass plus one family colour.
Glyph and base have the same hue and similar value (cream/gold check on a gold coin).
Tappable side badge or button below thumb size (about 48 pt) in the mock or build.

decision.send: score >= tier sendThreshold AND no hard fail AND no criterion <= 4 AND all 8 Lead questions answered yes
decision.fix_first: any hard fail, or a criterion <= 4, or score between dropBelow and the threshold: a worker redoes it with the failing criteria named; the owner does not see it
decision.drop: score < dropBelow, or 2 or more hard fails, or the same asset/family was already NOT for the same reason: stop iterating, re-brief from scratch or cut the asset

fixes_after_misses: fx tier with threshold 62 and a squint test
calibration.caveat: Not fully blind: the NOT list was in the brief. The fixes were made after seeing the misses and are not tested on fresh data.
